scope: Closed, bevelled world-drop coins. Reuse the accepted sun-face raster unchanged on both faces; retain all 15 denomination classes and their native mass/value/stack rules.
authority: Author 2026-11-13 requests actual 3D for every droppable inventory object, with questions deferred.
dimensions_note: Radius is measured from the existing opaque icon silhouette in art pixels. Mesh thickness/profile are display art coordinates, not new physical dimensions. Existing actor Radius, Height, Scale and 1g unit weight are unchanged.
provenance: Existing owned source pixels and hashes are retained in assets/manifests/sprites_v4.json. Original icons and world sprites are preserved. New geometry is generated deterministically from this data; no external artwork or Doom assets.
